rngv0160.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Vesuvius Fir Fibre Optic Christmas Tree
rngv0160.sourceDescription: The 3ft Vesuvius Fir fibre optic tree has all the razzle dazzle you need to get everybody in the holiday mood. Replete with seven colour-changing LEDs that change autonomously, the wonderful kaleidoscopic effects offer a lighting display unlike any other fibre optic Christmas tree. Around 60% of the tree displays warm white fibres, while the remaining fibres flash and wave in the seven different colours. The 3ft Vesuvius Fir is a fantastic option for anyone looking for a lively, pre-lit Christmas tree that doesn't need to be decorated. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. srx01y2g.sourceDescription: Bring this LED palm tree to your home right now! The green leaves and brown trunk are decorated for sparkling. LED tree: This party decoration features with 88 warm white energy-efficient LEDs, which illuminate your home with light.8 lighting effects: The artificial tree features 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade.Perfect decoration: Seated in a jute fabric covered base for a rustic look, this artificial plant makes a perfect accent to your home decoration. Its attractive appearance is pleasant scenery when displayed at parties, festivals and more. Note:If you use the product outdoors, please ensure that the USB connection is plugged indoors in a dry environment.The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included.Each product comes with an assembly manual in the box for easy assembly. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

jwb5qcy0.sourceDescription: The Pre-lit Ultra Devonshire Half Tree is a "half tree" version of our best selling Ultra Devonshire range, designed to stand against a wall, this tree offers the same look of the Ultra Devonshire tree range whilst taking up half the space! The range provides a number of different sized artificial trees, from 4ft to 7ft, so it's easy to find the perfect size for your room or venue. The outer layer of the tree is made from one of the most realistic and high-quality PE tips available, whilst the inner layer of traditional PVC branch tips fill out any gaps in the branches creating a voluminous full tree. Coming Pre-lit with multi-function warm white LED lights and hinged branches, this tree is quick and easy to erect. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase.
